sources.locator: "COVID-19 pandemic in the United States", revision 1374802509, lead

explanation: The American article opens on the outbreak this atlas dates from Wuhan and then on its arrival: "On 31 December 2019, China announced the discovery of a cluster of pneumonia cases in Wuhan. The first American case of COVID-19 was reported on January 20, and Health and Human Services Secretary Alex Azar declared a public health emergency on January 31." Caused and not enabled: it is the same epidemic, reported twenty days later in another country. Probable: Wikipedia alone.
